protocol.database: disposable PostgreSQL with real RLS and migrations
protocol.decision_gate: GO for a separate batching implementation ticket if owner/credential statements consume more than half of measured flush time at B=100 or B=1000. Otherwise NO-GO.
protocol.array_order: Five repetitions in raw-log order; no pooling of percentiles. Producer-control ratios compare the corresponding repetition index in separately timed workloads.
protocol.signature_recipe: SHA-256 of JSON of complete sorted owner and credential UsageMetricBucket rows, with timestamps normalized to UTC; fixture verifies every row on every sample.
protocol.timing_boundary: Flush or recording call only. Reset, seed, verification, subsequent flush and concurrent first-event coordination excluded. Clock/counter instrumentation included.
protocol.allocation_boundary: Process allocations while Go benchmark timer is active, including concurrent producer work after the first event; not isolated goroutine allocations.
protocol.statement_boundary: Forwarded connection-pool calls; five RLS setup statements counted separately from data SQL and begin/commit/rollback.

recommendation.scope: Separate batching implementation ticket for the measured B=100 and B=1000 cardinalities; no production-frequency, savings, or batching-speedup claim.
recommendation.candidate: Group complete owner primary keys, sum additive counters, retain maxima and latest timestamps, then upsert owner and credential rows in chunks of at most 1000 within the existing flush-ledger transaction and RLS context.
recommendation.obligations: Preserve attribution, replay idempotency, ledger and both-table atomic rollback, complete row values, and recording retained by the next flush.

local_checks.command: env -u DATABASE_URL DENSE_MEM_REPOSITORY_TESTCONTAINERS=1 go -C cmd/e2e run . --root ../.. --phase precheck --capability operations --case repository/TestUsageMetricsFlushScalingCardinalities,repository/TestUsageMetricsFlushScalingCommittedRetryPreservesNewEvents,repository/TestUsageMetricsFlushScalingFailureRollsBackLedgerAndBothTables,repository/TestUsageMetricsFlushScalingConcurrentRecording

verification.evaluation_1k: Explicit historical waiver recorded in issue #493; replacement evidence is real PostgreSQL correctness and source-identified scaling measurements.
verification.sample_correctness: All 45000 measured operations and all warmups/calibrations verify complete rows, sums, maxima and timestamps; concurrent samples also verify the subsequent flush.

maintenance_benefit: Measured per-bucket SQL cost and exact correctness obligations provide a reproducible decision for a separately approved batching ticket.
